audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Shen levels 2 and 3 while the whys for those rows explicitly call them Nautilus' best window, and gave Skill at levels 4-5 and 6 where the prose says the lane slips away.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Skill, Nautilus, Nautilus, Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen — matching the kits (Spirit's Refuge is a 10-16s block that only comes online later).
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Nautilus, Nautilus, Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen with ratings to match.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 2-3 window, level 6 Stand United, first item Spirit's Refuge, late Shen scaling — consistent with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states that Stand United is interruptible, and the text instead treats Shen's R as an unanswerable get-out.
audit.why: Riot flags Stand United as a channel: Staggering Blow's root, Dredge Line's pull or Depth Charge's knock-up cancels it outright.
audit.corrected: Interrupt the channel — a root, hook or Depth Charge landed during the cast stops the map-wide save. Also stated: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10 at 600 range, Spirit's Refuge 16/14.5/13/11.5/10.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — I have no Q engage or W shield yet, and Shen just farms with Q-empowered last-hits while neither of us can commit.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — you have no Q engage or W shield yet, and Shen just farms with Twilight Assault last-hits while neither can commit.

edits.before: At 2 my Q pull into passive root and E slow give me a real trade before his W block is reliably online — my best window.
edits.after: At 2 your Dredge Line into passive root and Riptide slow win a real trade before Spirit's Refuge is online — your best window.

edits.before: With Q-W-E up I can chain CC and a charged Titan's Wrath auto chunks him before his W (Spirit's Refuge) neuters my autos.
edits.after: With Q-W-E up you chain CC and charged Titan's Wrath autos chunk him before Spirit's Refuge, down 10-16s, blanks them.

edits.before: His W block and sustain scale up and start eating the autos my CC sets up — my front-loaded pressure stops converting to damage.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks the autos your CC sets up and Shadow Dash falls to 10-12s — your front-loaded pressure stops converting.

edits.before: Shen's R lets him tank my full lockdown chain and walk away, and his global ult outclasses my lane-bound engage pressure.
edits.after: Stand United is a channel you can cancel with a root or hook, but his global saves still outclass your lane-bound engage.

edits.before: His W blocks my charged Titan's Wrath autos and passive proc on demand, and his E-taunt flips my slow Q walk-up trades.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks your charged Titan's Wrath autos and passive proc, and Shadow Dash taunts your walk-up trades back.

edits.before: Late we're both CC tanks, but he out-scales me with global R, taunt-peel, and a W that blanks the only damage I have.
edits.after: Late you are both CC tanks, but he out-scales you with global R, taunt-peel, and a W that blanks the only damage you have.

edits.before: Shen's R lets him survive your full CC chain and turns any tower dive into a 2v1 — his global ult also outclasses your lane-bound pressure.
edits.after: Stand United is a channel — your passive root, Dredge Line or Depth Charge cancels it outright, so interrupt the cast instead of eating the 2v1.

edits.before: Whiffing hook and walking forward anyway — your kill threat IS the hook; without it you are a slow shield.
edits.after: Stand United is a channel — hook him or Depth Charge him mid-cast and the map-wide save never happens at all.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — I have no Q engage and no W shield yet, and Shen just sits on Q-empowered last-hits. My only real edge is levels 2-3: once I have Q-W-E I can land a Dredge Line pull into my passive root and an E slow before his W is reliably up, and a charged Titan's Wrath auto chunks him in that window. Take that trade and only that trade. The instant he has W (Spirit's Refuge) charges, my whole auto-based pattern dies — never throw a Q into him when he can just block the follow-up and E-taunt me back.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — you have no Q engage and no W shield yet, and Shen just sits on Twilight Assault last-hits. Your real edge is levels 2-3: with Q-W-E you land a Dredge Line pull into passive root and a Riptide slow before Spirit's Refuge is reliably up, and a charged Titan's Wrath auto chunks him in that window. Take that trade and only that trade. The instant Spirit's Refuge is up your auto pattern dies — never throw Q into him when he can block the follow-up and Shadow Dash you back.

edits.before: From 4-5 it slips away. Shen scales his W block and his sustain, and my front-loaded CC stops translating to damage because he simply nullifies the autos that hurt. At 6 it gets worse — my R is a great pick tool, but Depth Charge into his face just feeds his R: he tanks my whole passive-root-Q-R-E chain, taunts me, and walks away, or his teammate collapses while his global ult is saving a lane across the map. Do not greed all-ins here. Bait his W and his taunt, poke with E shockwaves, and look to roam or gank instead of forcing a duel I no longer win.
edits.after: From 4-5 it slips away. Spirit's Refuge scales to a 10-second cooldown and your front-loaded CC stops translating to damage, because he nullifies the autos that hurt. At 6, Stand United is a channel — a root, hook or Depth Charge cancels it — but spent into his face your R just feeds the taunt: he tanks the chain and walks away while his global saves a lane across the map. Do not greed all-ins. Bait Spirit's Refuge and Shadow Dash, poke with Riptide, and roam or gank instead of forcing a duel you no longer win.

edits.before: This is Shen's game outright. We're both CC-bots with no carry damage, but he's the better one — global R presence, a taunt that peels and engages, and a W that blanks the autos I'd need to actually kill anyone. My lockdown chain gets me one target; his ult gets him the whole map. My only path is to have ended this before items mattered — snowball a 2-3 lead off that early window and convert it into towers and objectives. If the game goes long, I'm a worse version of him, so I play for picks with R and peel for my carries rather than pretend I can 1v1 him.
edits.after: This is Shen's game outright. You are both CC-bots with no carry damage, but he is the better one — global R presence, a taunt that peels and engages, and a W that blanks the autos you need to kill anyone. Your lockdown chain gets one target; his ult gets the whole map, unless you cancel the channel. Your path is to have ended this before items mattered — snowball a 2-3 lead off that early window into towers and objectives. If the game goes long, play for picks with R and peel for your carries rather than 1v1 him.

notes: Content layer was written in first person ('I have no Q engage') throughout whys, early, mid and late — converted to the site's second-person voice at the same length. Nautilus' own ability names (Dredge Line, Titan's Wrath, Riptide, Staggering Blow, Depth Charge) are used where the text said 'my Q/W/E'.
